Type: chair
Name: Pinzon Crescent Bay Armchair, Stripe
Colors: Stripe
Handsome arm chair in versatile, blue and beige wide-striped fabric enhances any decor Hardwood frame; foam cushion; helical springs for comfort; hand crafted in the USA 100-percent organic cotton fabric needs only spot cleaning for care; no assembly required Coordinates with the Pinzon Crescent Bay Furniture Collection Chair measures 37 inches high by 34 inches wide by 34 inches deep
